text:
maria: noticed a reproducible ordering regression when a streaming connection is idled ~4-6s and the gateway transfers the lease. trace tr_stream_901 (link)
ajay: steps to reproduce?
maria: open stream -> pause network ~5s -> gateway hands off -> client observes two partial chunks swapped.
charlie: are we ordering by per-connection seq numbers?
maria: yes. seqs reset on new lease so different proxies can emit overlapping seqs. downstream merger only uses seq to order.
lin: proposal: add X-Stream-Epoch header bound to logical stream id. increment epoch on lease transfer. order by (stream_id, epoch, seq).
ajay: need handoff control to include last_ack_offset so new proxy can request safe replay.
charlie: replay unsafe for side-effecting tool/function calls. default to resume-only; allow opt-in replay for marked-safe streams.
maria: tradeoffs: blocking transfer until acks is simpler but hurts eviction latency. epoch+replay increases complexity but improves availability for read-only streams.
lin: add a tiny merge buffer (50-200ms) to absorb transient reordering during epoch flips.
charlie: observability: epoch_bump_count, replay_requests, epoch_mismatch_drops, handoff_block_seconds. console should show warnings when live streams bump epoch.
ops-bot: deploy queued: staging/gateway candidate at 2026-03-21T15:42:00Z
maria: i'll draft RFC with trace, proto sketch, and repro. target: RFC tomorrow morning.
